question: Where can I get a list of stand-alone battery storage (BESS) projects currently in permitting in France, with location, power (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: No unified French registry tracks all stand-alone BESS currently in permitting. Nationally, the Ministry portal NOVAE exposes an open API and Excel export for R.122-2 environmental screening (cas par cas) and opinions, including open cases, though MW and developer appear only inside attached PDFs and smaller sites below thresholds are omitted. Major full-EIA consultations appear on projets-environnement.gouv.fr. Most BESS (>600 kW Li-ion) file an ICPE 2925-2 Déclaration whose receipts are scattered across 101 departmental Préfectures, while pending building permits are excluded from Sitadel (CRPA L.311-2).
main_caveats: NOVAE inProgress=true omits 'À COMPLÉTER' dossiers (missing open standalone BESS 005778/KK P in Œuilly, 5 MW); query without inProgress or filter documentStatus manually.
Most 1-20+ MW standalone BESS require only ICPE 2925-2 Déclaration (>600 kW) plus Permis de construire/DP, so projects below R.122-2 thresholds never appear in NOVAE unless filed voluntarily.
Sitadel excludes all pending building permits ('en cours d'instruction') under CRPA art. L.311-2, omits permits without floor area, and strips project descriptions.
Géorisques ICPE covers only active/ended Autorisation and Enregistrement facilities, excluding 2925-2 Déclaration-only BESS and pending applications.
Grid queue datasets (ODRÉ, Enedis data-fair, EDF Corse-Outremer, RTE Cartostock, Caparéseau) publish substation MW headroom or regional totals, never named permitting projects.

steps: Query GET /api/PublishedDocument/Get with searchAll keywords ('batterie', 'batteries', 'stockage', 'BESS') using length=250 and start=0,250,... without inProgress=true so 'À COMPLÉTER' dossiers are included (or export Excel via /api/PublishedDocument/ExportToExcel?start=0&searchAll=batterie).
Deduplicate by id and filter projectTitle to separate stand-alone BESS from co-located solar PV+battery, hydro STEP, hydrogen, gigafactory, recycling and municipal name matches ('Bessin', 'Bessée').

Inspect documentStatus: 'En cours d'instruction' and 'À COMPLÉTER' are open in NOVAE; recent 'Dossier Clos' cas par cas decisions (within ~12 months) typically denote projects now moving into urbanism (PC) and ICPE permitting.

For each kept project, call /api/PublishedDocument/GetByDocumentId?documentId={documentId} and download Cerfa/decision PDFs via /api/Attachment/PublishedDownload?ctsFileId={id} to extract MW, MWh, developer name/SIRET and DMS/Lambert coordinates (e.g. ctsFileId=116049 for Œuilly, ctsFileId=458012 for Batilly-en-Gâtinais).
reading_traps: inProgress=true returns 373 records ('En cours d'instruction', 'Recevable', 'Validé Niveau I', 'En Cours') but SILENTLY EXCLUDES 'À COMPLÉTER', omitting open stand-alone BESS 2080/10805 (005778/KK P, Œuilly 5 MW).
In PublishedDocument/Get?searchAll=BESS, full-text matches town names containing 'Bess' (e.g. Cricqueville-en-Bessin, L'Argentière-la-Bessée ALDI store), inflating hits unless titles are filtered.
JSON and ExportToExcel omit MW/MWh, developer and coordinates completely; those fields reside only inside attached Cerfa or signed decision PDFs.
HEAD requests to PublishedDocument/Get return HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed; always use HTTP GET.

71 of 73 non-PV/non-factory standalone BESS-matched dossiers in NOVAE show documentStatus='Dossier Clos' because environmental cas-par-cas concludes in ~35 days prior to building permit/ICPE construction permitting.

problems: HEAD returns 405 Method Not Allowed; ExportToExcel fails silently or returns subsets if start/filters vary; inProgress=true excludes 'À COMPLÉTER'; MW and developer missing from structured fields.

related_not_answering.name: Enedis Open Data / EDF SEI / ODRÉ — Projets en développement et Files d'attente
related_not_answering.why: Publishes regional/departmental/power-bracket aggregated MW counts (and 75 ZNI territory aggregates for EDF Corse-Outremer), no individual project names or permitting status.

related_not_answering.name: RTE Cartostock & Caparéseau
related_not_answering.why: Interactive maps displaying remaining MW substation grid-hosting headroom for storage/renewables, not individual BESS projects in permitting.

related_not_answering.name: European Energy Storage Inventory (EC JRC)
related_not_answering.why: Public Qlik viewer aggregating operational, under-construction and announced European assets from public data and Wood Mackenzie; provides neither downloadable API nor French permitting stage tracking.

open_questions: No government source quantifies how many >600 kW Li-ion stand-alone BESS files are currently within the 15-day ICPE 2925-2 standstill or awaiting DDT/Préfet Permis de construire nationwide across the 101 departments without full crawling/OCR.

Whether a pending BESS whose R.122-2 cas par cas closed on NOVAE ('Dossier Clos', e.g. Batilly-en-Gâtinais 108 MW on 2026-10-08) is currently in DDT PC instruction, delayed, or abandoned cannot be resolved without checking local municipal/DDT records.

history.note: Initial survey: no unified national BESS permitting registry; NOVAE covers R.122-2 cas par cas, 101 Prefectures hold ICPE 2925-2 PDFs, Sitadel excludes pending PC.

local_terms.meaning: ICPE rubric for non-H2 (Li-ion) battery systems >600 kW, subject to Déclaration (D)
Official ICPE Declaration filing receipt published on departmental Préfecture websites for 3 years (R.512-49)
Environmental screening (R.122-2) handled via NOVAE to decide if a full EIA is required
Unified environmental permit required for major projects crossing AENV/EIA/IOTA/species thresholds
Urban planning permits (>20 m² footprint triggers PC; instructed by DDT for Préfet under L.422-2/R.422-2)
Public inquiry or electronic public participation required before EIA-subject project decisions
HTB/HTA substation and grid hosting capacity mapped on RTE Cartostock and Caparéseau

provenance.note: Minutes are researcher estimates. Counts describe documented passes, not publication approval. Missing history or effort is not reconstructed.
